page_title: ACM 0-1 UDI | AC Milan v Udinese 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+5' The referee blows his whistle, AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.

90+4' A big opportunity is wasted by Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, Marco Silvestri pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AC Milan.
90+2' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90+1' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

90+1' What a save from Marco Silvestri! Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
87' AC Milan have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing. The ball is out of play. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner.
85' Festy Ebosele goes off the pitch and Joao Ferreira (Udinese) comes on.
84' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to substitute Jordan Zemura and he is replaced by Hassane Kamara (Udinese).
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Isaac Success as he is replaced by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese).
84' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
83' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' Stefano Pioli has decided to make a change. Luka Romero (AC Milan) replaces Yunus Musah.
81' The manager makes a subsitution with Florian Thauvin (Udinese) coming on for Lazar Samardzic.
80' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Now AC Milan have a corner.
78' A quickly taken corner by AC Milan.
73' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Juan Luca Sacchi no option but to blow his whistle.
72' That's the end of the game for Martin Payero, who is replaced by Sandi Lovric (Udinese).
72' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
70' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
68' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) takes the corner but it's cleared.
67' It is time for a substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) is on for Tijjani Reijnders.
67' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.
67' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
65' The corner from Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) is intercepted by the defence.
61' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Mike Maignan no chance!
61' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
61' A clumsy foul by Yacine Adli (AC Milan) and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle. PENALTY! One of the players from Udinese is about to take a penalty kick.
59' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
58' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
57' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
55' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
54' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
54' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
54' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jordan Zemura (Udinese). The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
51' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
49' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post.
48' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar.
47' Corner kick. Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) is ready to send the ball into the box.
46' Stefano Pioli makes a switch. Noah Okafor is coming on in place of Luka Jovic (AC Milan) at the start of the second period.
46' Here is a change. Rade Krunic is going off and Stefano Pioli gives the last tactical orders to Yacine Adli (AC Milan).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but Marco Silvestri punches the ball away.
45' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
44' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
39' Martin Payero (Udinese) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.

34' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Marco Silvestri thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
32' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
30' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
27' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
26' AC Milan take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

25' That didn't go as planned! Davide Calabria (AC Milan) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Marco Silvestri, who easily kept it out. AC Milan get a corner.

21' Rade Krunic (AC Milan) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
21' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) steps up to send the ball in.
21' A lofted cross from Davide Calabria (AC Milan) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. AC Milan have a corner.
19' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
19' Rade Krunic (AC Milan) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
15' A cross into the box from Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) is cleared. It's a throw-in for Udinese.
13' Rade Krunic (AC Milan) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The linesman signals a throw-in for AC Milan.
9' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches over the bar.
9' AC Milan are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
7' The resulting corner from Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
7' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. AC Milan force their opponents to concede a corner.
6' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
4' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Silvestri, who smothers the ball.
3' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Juan Luca Sacchi.
